title: Pinterest Hobbies Trend Report 2026: Find your joy
claim: Pinterest named 'Kitchen Witch' one of nine fall-2026 hobby trends and reported search increases for related terms.
excerpt: Search summaries of this page: Kitchen Witch is one of nine trends (with Cosmic Reset, Home Cafe Engineering, Backyard Botanist, Weekend Equestrian, Secondhand Sidequest, Handmade Hacker, Curated Clutter, Casual Crafter); searches for 'herbal apothecary' +595%, 'midnight margaritas' +140%, 'candle making tutorial' +118%, homemade spice blends +209%, kombucha scoby recipes +201%, beeswax wrap tutorials +250%. Figures are Pinterest's own; page not fetched (blocked).
